source.title: Neonatal methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus conjunctivitis

source_integrity_notes: The supplied PDF contains parts of three PostScript articles. Only the target Sahu et al. article on printed pages 794-795 was treated as the publication under review.
The source reports no bacterial typing, so maternal or household transmission remains an author interpretation rather than a confirmed transmission chain.
The 0-36%, 40%, 68%, and 81% numerical statements come from cited literature. They are retained as secondary_reported_result atoms, not as primary results generated by this case.
The source does not report chloramphenicol, mupirocin, or chlorhexidine dose, frequency, or duration.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
